plan: Full experiment design delivered inline (no files created, no execution, no fabricated numbers). Sections covered: (1) Objective with explicit disambiguation of three gradient-graph artifacts and the key finding that Gᵃ (autograd backward graph) is structurally identical between arms, so the substantive comparison lives on Gᶠ (full per-step functional graph captured by torch.fx), with Gᵥ (torchviz DOT) as a secondary visualization channel. (2) Hypothesis in measurable terms: H1 fewer total/op nodes in Gᶠ for Fused arm, with reduction concentrated in optimizer_update bucket; H2 canonicalized per-parameter subgraphs collapse to ≤ c distinct hashes vs P in the unfused arm; H3 lower label entropy on rendered DOT; explicit null that Gᵃ is identical. (3) Design: two arms (Unfused = torch.optim.Adam; Fused = torchopt.FusedAdam with CUDA path and CPU-safe MetaAdam + torch.func.functional_call fallback), three model classes (Linear, 2-3 layer MLP, small CNN), single traced step (forward + backward + optimizer), N=3 deterministic trials. (4) Controls: shared seed, fresh init, fresh optimizer state, fixed dtype/device, pinned lr/betas/eps/weight_decay, fresh-subprocess isolation per (model×arm×trial). (5) Metrics: primary on torch.fx graph — |V|, |E|, depth, op-bucket histograms (optimizer_update/linalg/reduction/view/conv/fused_kernel/other), per-param subgraph dedup ratio + unique_hashes, serialized GraphModule size; secondary on torchviz DOT — dot_node_count, dot_longest_chain, label_entropy_H; human-rater rubric explicitly excluded per refinement. (6) Analysis plan: mean±stddev per (model,arm) over N=3, signed percent reduction Δ; a priori decision rule — ≥15% node-count reduction in ≥2 of 3 model classes plus ≥20% of removed nodes in the optimizer_update bucket for "less complex"; ≥50% increase in dup_ratio plus entropy reduction for "more interpretable"; pre-registered predictions recorded but not invented. (7) Feasibility: requires torch>=2.1, torchviz==0.0.2, torchopt>=0.2.0, system graphviz>=2.50, on a host with CUDA optional; the current bubblewrap runtime has none of these and network is disabled, so the design is to be implemented elsewhere — stated explicitly. (8) Threats to validity: autograd-graph equivalence between arms called out, single-step sufficiency, CPU-vs-CUDA fused path asymmetry, version pinning, tracing-library contamination (mitigated by fresh subprocesses), determinism, duplicate-subgraph metric sign-flip, FX functional-call lowering granularity, torchviz DOT truncation. (9) Deliverables: inline-only design document plus Appendices A (per-arm pseudocode for symbolic-traceable step), B (seed & init discipline), C (FX & DOT metric-extraction templates), D (decision-rule checklist). Everything returned in this message; no files created.
